target: a model that answers with findings under result — which is what the live model actually did — must still yield a top-level findings array, or every downstream reader sees zero
cmd: cat "$FIXTURES/findings/contract-brief.json" | MOCK_RESPONSE_FILE="$FIXTURES/findings/or-findings-under-result.json" bash "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/call_sol.sh" --mode adversary --via openrouter 2>/dev/null | jq -e '(.findings|length) == 1' >/dev/null && echo NORMALISED
